t: A snap together robotics platform for classrooms and competition, coded with VEXcode IQ.
steps: Find the VEX IQ kit and the VEX Library on the VEX site.
Confirm current prices with VEX or a reseller.
Build a simple robot and charge the IQ Brain.
Open VEXcode IQ in the app or the browser.
Connect the Brain and run a first drive.
Try a lesson from the CMU curriculum.
Read the VEX privacy policy before students create accounts.
